description: PowerCalc is the PowerCalc community's Home Assistant component for estimating appliance electricity consumption from device states and measured profiles. It creates virtual power and energy sensors for devices without direct metering, including lights, fans and media players. Inputs include brightness, colour, fan speed or a configured estimation strategy; outputs include power, accumulated energy, costs and grouped household totals. Coverage is supported appliances in a configured home, with time resolution following state updates. Source is free under MIT, and public documentation links a device-profile library. A limitation is that these are estimates, not independent meter observations; an unsuitable profile or changing appliance behaviour can bias them. The models can generate appliance-load assumptions for building energy simulations. CityLearn's environment and datasets (data-citylearn-environment-and-datasets) provide related building-demand context. No Home Assistant installation or device measurement was accessed.
